messages:
lina (Design): dropped a quick set of mocks: https://redwood.design/snapshots/2169300000_v1.png
lina (Design): idea: compact token "orb" that sits inside the message meta (left of time). three affordances for controlling streaming: 1) tiny inline stop chip, 2) floating circular control over message top-right, 3) hover mini-toolbar with contextual actions. also trying a subtle pulse for streaming that respects reduced-motion. feedback?
arpit (Product): like the orb placement — keeps the right side actions tidy. prefer the hover mini-toolbar for power users, but we need an always-visible keyboard-accessible control (for a11y and discoverability).
jules (Eng): implementation notes: we'll use AbortController for stop; client sends X-Request-Cancel header to backend on cancel. floating circular control is slightly harder (z-index + gestures) but doable. hover toolbar + keyboard menu seems lowest friction.
mira (Research): token orb behavior: show live token count when panel focused, otherwise show total tokens for the message. tooltip on hover with breakdown: prompt / completion / cached. compact delta mode is good for reducing noise. Also ran quick user probe — novices confused by unlabeled icons. need short tooltip text.
paul (QA): a11y and testing: contrast on the orb at 11px fails WCAG. need >=4.5:1. screenreader issue: each chunk of streaming fires an announcement; instead announce once at start ("Response is streaming") and announce final with the content. reduced-motion: ensure pulsing animation removed when prefers-reduced-motion is set. also add high-latency cancellation tests to ensure server free-up.
lina (Design): copy: "Stop" vs "Stop generation"? I think fuller copy helps discoverability but increases clutter. options: full copy in keyboard menu, terse label in hover toolbar.
arpit (Product): agree — terse in-situ, full text in menu. shortcut suggestions: Esc to stop, Shift+R to regenerate (scope to convo focus to avoid browser conflicts).
jules (Eng): we'll scope shortcuts to the conversation container, not global. Regen flow: snapshot current conversation state, call generation endpoint with same prompt, and track regen_id for metrics. Stop flow: abort in-flight stream, send cancel header, set client-side state to prevent further rendering.
mira (Research): prompt library drag-in: need clear insertion line and placeholder. keyboard users: add an "Insert" button on each card and allow focus + Enter to insert. propose preview action on Space or P. aria-live for preview details.
paul (QA): add to test plan: keyboard-only insert, screenreader announce on insert, drag-drop under Safari/VoiceOver. also verify token tooltip content is accessible (role="tooltip" and keyboard focusable).
lina (Design): updated mock v2 with explicit tooltips and accessible labels: https://redwood.design/snapshots/2169300000_v2.png
lina (Design): decided: hover mini-toolbar + keyboard menu + token orb left of time. in-situ label: "Stop"; menu shows "Stop generation" and "Regenerate response". will prototype reduced-motion variant.
jules (Eng): I'll spike the keyboard-scoped shortcuts and the abort header this sprint. will add e2e that simulates packet loss and asserts server receives cancel. cc @mira for prompt-library keyboard spec.
design-bot: heads up — design sync tomorrow 11:00 PDT. attach final mock in Figma before EOD today. :spiral_calendar:
